name: nodehammer_core.h
banner: The connector tier minus its importers: the handle types, the diagnostics,
Not a tier anyone ships. It exists so the amalgamation can be built and run
in a plain build -- no ROOT, no DD4hep -- which is what makes it a usable
smoke test of the assembly itself. nodehammer_connect.h is this plus the
two importers, and adds no machinery beyond more files.
